components.name: Primary review action
components.description: The original desk review action; the live label is supplied by its service. This token specimen does not carry the inherited text-arrow glyph into a new primitive.

components.name: Globe and Horizon lenses
components.description: Native framing choices, shown as the phone text-only pair. Rendering and motion stay with the native globe.
components.css: .ds-lenses{display:flex;width:fit-content;border:1px solid #454540;border-radius:4px;background:#000}.ds-lenses button{min-width:48px;min-height:44px;padding:8px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:#000;color:#d4d4cb;font:400 12px/1.3 "Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:color 140ms,background-color 140ms,transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)}.ds-lenses button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#fff;color:#000}.ds-lenses button:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-lenses button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffd700;outline-offset:4px;transform:none}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-lenses button:not([aria-pressed="true"]):hover{background:#17180e;color:#fff}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-lenses button{transition:none;transform:none}}

components.name: Service choice row
components.description: A ruled native need choice. The native service provides any price label; no fee is invented in the specimen.
components.html: <button class="ds-service-choice" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Find a home for me</button>

components.name: Phone Full view
components.description: The existing expand control uses its SVG alone on phones and retains Full view as its accessible name and title. The live button opens the original dialog.

narrative.overview:
Airspace gives the original BOOM destination and service a continuous setting:
an open black geographic scene meets a white decision surface. The yellow
identity, Helvetica Neue light voice, original Solari pulse and native globe
carry the established BOOM character. The composition is direct and spacious;
the offer is ordinary readable content, with its actual terms and next action.

This document describes only the opt-in Dispatch Airspace composition. It does
not replace the root BOOM design system, PRODUCT.md, Club or the other Flight
compositions. Its runtime boundary is Club direction and edition, Panorama
experience, Dispatch vision, `composition=airspace`, and Europe readiness.
The design choice was delegated in the current direction contract. Tokens below
are extracted from the implementation, not a new brand proposal.
keyCharacteristics: One native geographic scene and one original decision surface.
Black, white and BOOM yellow; light headlines and restrained controls.
Complete city choices without a horizontal carousel.
Actual service, fee and conditions, followed by the native review action.
Original motion ownership, pause and reduced-motion paths.

rules.name: The Content White Rule
rules.body: In Airspace, white holds the actual decision and company content; it is not a porcelain frame around the geographic scene.

rules.name: The Original Voice Rule
rules.body: Preserve Helvetica Neue weight (300) for the Airspace headings and keep the original logo and Solari; do not substitute a new display family or redraw those identity assets.

rules.name: The Native Depth Rule
rules.body: Let the real geography and Solari provide depth; do not add an ornamental HUD, second globe, paper entrance or shadowed shell.

rules.name: The Single Owner Rule
rules.body: Change presentation through the original owners; add no animation clock, customer state, catalogue, form or payment path.

dos: Do keep this system scoped to the opt-in Airspace composition.
Do move the original globe, forms and service nodes with their native owners.
Do preserve all six city choices, keyboard access, pause and reduced motion.
Do show actual service conditions and failure states before the native action.
Do keep the phone Full view icon in the control row with its accessible name.
Do distinguish implementation evidence from completed visual and browser review.
donts: Don't apply this composition as a global BOOM rebrand or replace other variants.
Don't restore the rejected porcelain surround or rounded outer frame in Airspace.
Don't add another timer, canvas, form, customer state or commercial summary.
Don't introduce fake proof, invented fees, generated founder imagery or new offices.
Don't promote inherited glyph arrows or decorative labels into new system primitives.
